dialogues.speaker: Yareche
dialogues.text: Well, here's the thing: You know this place got trashed by the Abyss, right? My teacher, Matzil, was wounded in action and is recuperating at home.

dialogues.speaker: Yareche
dialogues.text: She's entrusted these little Saurians to my care in the meantime, and... *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Yareche
dialogues.text: Sorry, please don't get me wrong. I don't hate them. I just don't know how to communicate with them.

dialogues.speaker: Yareche
dialogues.text: How can my teacher chat with them so easily when they clearly don't speak the same language...
